scripts.setup: npm install && npm run cli:build && ./bloud setup
scripts.lint:go: npm run lint:go:host-agent && npm run lint:go:apps && npm run lint:go:cli
scripts.lint: npm run lint:go && npm run check:gofmt && npm run lint:web && npm run lint:prose && npm run check:no-emdash && npm run check:docs-links
scripts.lint:prose: [ -d .vale/styles/Google ] || npm run lint:prose:sync && go run github.com/vale-cli/vale/v3/cmd/vale@v3.22.0 --no-global $(git ls-files '*.md' '*.go' '*.ts' '*.js' '*.svelte' '*.yml' '*.yaml' '*.css' '*.html' '*.sql')
scripts.check:gofmt: out=$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files '*.go')); [ -z "$out" ] && exit 0; printf 'gofmt needed:\n%s\n' "$out"; exit 1
scripts.test:go: cd services/host-agent && go run gotest.tools/gotestsum@latest --format testdox ./...
scripts.test:go:apps: cd apps && go run gotest.tools/gotestsum@latest --format testdox ./...
scripts.test:go:all: npm run test:go && npm run test:go:apps
scripts.test:go:coverage: cd services/host-agent && go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./... && go tool cover -func=coverage.out | tail -1
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:go:all && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:precommit: npm run license:check && npm run check:app-http && npm run lint && npm run test:go:all && npm run test:ts
